HOUSING AUTHORITY MEETING 2/6/13 - 6:00 PM
HOUSING AUTHORITY MEETING 2/6/13 - 6:00 PM
CITY HALL COUNCIL CHAMBER
38300 SIERRA HIGHWAY, SUITE B
PALMDALE, CALIFORNIA
FEBRUARY 06, 2013
06:00 P.M.
AGENDA NO. 87
www.cityofpalmdale.org
WELCOME
NOTICE: This meeting will be webcasted live at www.cityofpalmdale.org and broadcasted live on Spectrum Channel 27.
NOTE: Materials related to an item on this Agenda submitted to the Council or any of its Authorities after distribution of the agenda packet will be available for public inspection at themeeting and after themeeting in the City Clerk's office, located at 38300 Sierra Highway, Ste. C during normal business hours. Those items provided by others at the meeting will be available in the City Clerk's office during normal business hours.
For record keeping purposes and in the event that staff may need to contact you, we request that a speaker's form, located on the table in the foyer, be completed and deposited with the City Clerk. This will then be public information. Please note that you are not required to complete this form or state your name and residence in order to speak. A three-minute time limit will be imposed on all speakers other than staff members.
In accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990, if you require a disability-related modification or accommodation to attend or participate in this meeting, including auxiliary aids or services, please call the City Clerk's Office at (661) 267-5151 at least 48 hours prior to the meeting.
Your courtesy is requested to help our meeting run smoothly. If you'll be kind enough to follow these simple rules, we can make the best possible use of your time and ours:
Please refrain from public displays or outbursts such as unsolicited applause, comments, cheering, foul language, or obscenities.
Any disruptive activities that substantially interfere with the ability of the City Council to carry out its meeting will not be permitted and offenders will be requested to leave the meeting.
Please turn off or mute your cell phones and mobile devices.
1. CALL TO ORDER.
2. ROLL CALL: CHAIR LEDFORD, VICE CHAIR LACKEY, COMMISSIONERS BETTENCOURT, DISPENZA, HOFBAUER, BROWN, AND SANCHEZ
3. CLOSED SESSION - PUBLIC COMMENTS:
4. PRESENTATION BY AUTHORITY ATTORNEY of the item to be discussed in Closed Session:
4.1 The reason for holding a closed session is for the purpose of conferring with and/or receiving advice from the Authority's legal counsel and to receive direction from the Housing Authority regarding the following pending litigation to which the Housing Authority is a party:
Housing Authority of the City of Palmdale v. Wu, et al.
Los Angeles County Superior Court Case No. MC 023 481
This closed session is being held pursuant to the authority of California Government Code Sections 54956.9 & 54956.9(a). Closed session is recommended because the Housing Authority will assess the merits and weaknesses of this matter and consider the Authority's perspective. Based on existing facts and circumstances it is my opinion that it would prejudice the position of the Authority to discuss this matter in public.
5. CLOSED SESSION.
6. ANNOUNCEMENT BY AUTHORITY ATTORNEY of the item discussed in Closed Session.
7. PUBLIC COMMENTS:
8. ADJOURNMENT.
